Problem 2. Fermi acceleration (10.0 points) Cosmic rays contain extremely high energy particles. A possible mechanism for the appearance of such particles is called Fermi acceleration.
entries.ko: 문제 2. 페르미 가속 (10.0점) 우주선에는 에너지가 매우 큰 입자가 포함된다. 이러한 입자가 생성되는 가능한 원리 가운데 하나가 페르미 가속이다.

entries.source: Fermi acceleration is a stochastical mechanism for the acceleration that charged particles experience when they are repeatedly reflected, usually by magnetic mirrors. In this problem, we consider the main ideas underlying this paradoxical, at first glance, phenomenon.
entries.ko: 페르미 가속은 대전입자가 주로 자기 거울에서 반복해서 반사될 때 일어나는 확률적 가속 과정이다. 이 문제에서는 언뜻 역설적으로 보이는 이 현상의 기본 원리를 살펴본다.

provenance.translation: Manual Korean translation of the original English section, pages 1–6. Original figures, equations and numbering retained.
provenance.source_note: The original labels parts 1.1 and 1.3 as 4.0 points and 1.2 as 3.0, while the Problem 1 heading states 10.0. Printed source values retained. The English wording of part 2.1 reverses the overtaking subject. Korean follows the Russian statement on original page 17 and the specified lane speeds: B overtakes cars in A. The English/Russian source embeds three blank transparent images where much-less-than signs belong. Restored << in part 3.3 and the two small-x appendix conditions, explicitly confirmed by the Kazakh text on original pages 13–14.
